reviewScope: Targeted source review; not a compliance assessment or penetration test

risks.name: Agent Goal Hijack
risks.controls: Added untrusted-input instructions to entity extraction and explanation prompts. Existing typed entity schema. Analyst does not execute tools.
risks.gaps: Prompt wording cannot prevent injection. Need adversarial tests and audit of authority claims feeding registry checks.

risks.name: Tool Misuse and Exploitation
risks.controls: Fixed analysis routes; explicit PDF/financial consent; validated endpoints; browser requests reject redirects. PDF extraction never follows links.
risks.gaps: Need complete SSRF review, hosted API authorization and request rate limits.

risks.name: Identity and Privilege Abuse
risks.controls: Removed prototype hardcoded credential; environment variable used. Browser backend wildcard CORS now disables credentials. Local mode restricts destinations.
risks.gaps: Previously committed credential requires owner-side revocation. CORS is not authentication. Need hosted service roles and scoped identities.

risks.name: Agentic Supply Chain Vulnerabilities
risks.controls: Existing signed extension contracts and permission validation; website-source records and certificate validation.
risks.gaps: Contracts do not authenticate the runtime bundle. Need pinned dependencies/model revisions, SBOM, vulnerability scans and release signing.

risks.name: Unexpected Code Execution
risks.controls: PDF scripts/actions are not executed. Observed media subprocess calls use argument lists. LLM analyst has no generated-code executor.
risks.gaps: Need parser isolation, decompression/CPU limits and full model-deserialization review.

risks.name: Memory and Context Poisoning
risks.controls: New untrusted-context prompt boundaries; pending community reviews do not promote whitelist entries. Existing stale-result invalidation and expiring personal preferences.
risks.gaps: Need corpus provenance auditing, tamper-resistant refreshes and tenant separation.

risks.name: Insecure Inter-Agent Communication
risks.controls: Separate typed pipelines; no deployed cross-agent delegation service identified. Browser requests omit credentials and refuse redirects.
risks.gaps: No universal authenticated service channel. Need TLS, service identity, replay protection and access scopes for distributed operation.

risks.name: Cascading Failures
risks.controls: Existing request timeouts, unavailable-evidence handling, local-first scans and PDF size/page/link limits. Reload invalidation stops WhatsApp polling.
risks.gaps: Need circuit breakers, resource isolation and global request limits. PDF page limits alone do not bound CPU or decompression.

risks.name: Human-Agent Trust Exploitation
risks.controls: No-signals wording avoids a safety guarantee; evidence availability is separate from website trust. PDF consent discloses full-document upload.
risks.gaps: Need live usability tests and audit of model-generated explanations. User approval can still be manipulated.

risks.name: Rogue Agents
risks.controls: No self-replicating agent or unrestricted tool-running analyst identified. User modes and signed contracts provide limited boundaries.
risks.gaps: Proposed orchestrator rules are documentation, not runtime enforcement. Need centralized audit, kill switch and delegated-agent policy if autonomy is introduced.
